Package com.eloview.sdk.systemManager

Class System

java.lang.Object
com.eloview.sdk.consts.Consts
com.eloview.sdk.accountManager.AccountManager
com.eloview.sdk.systemManager.System
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class System extends AccountManager
System class provides below operations.
  • Get an auth token using getEloAccessToken.
  • Capture the device screenshot using captureScreenShot.
  • Set Device orientation in portrait, landscape, reverse-portrait or reverse-landscape using setOrientation.
  • Get Device orientation. For e.g. portrait, landscape using getOrientation.
  • Factory reset device without any user interaction. It deletes the user data partition using factoryReset.
  • Reboot the device silently using silentReboot.
  • Enable/Disable NavigationBar in Standard AndroidMode using setNavigationBarEnabled.
  • Enable/Disable StatusBar in Standard AndroidMode using setStatusBarEnabled.
  • Allow all runtime permissions so application does not pop up permission dialog using setGrantAllAppPermissionEnabled.
  • Get property status of NavigationBar using getNavigationBarEnabled.
  • Get property status of StatusBar using getStatusBarEnabled.
  • Get property status of GrantAllAppPermission using getGrantAllAppPermissionEnabled.
  • Set BackLightTimeOut property using setBacklightTimeOut.
  • Get property status of BackLightTimeOut using getBacklightTimeOut.
  • Set System Password Lock using setLockScreenPassword.
  • Change System Password Lock using changeLockScreenPassword.
  • Auto grant runtime USB permissions in Android Home Mode using autoallowUSBPermission
  • Lock or unlock the secure processor firmware on M60/M60C devices using setFirmwareStatusLockEnabled
  • APIs to set/change the device pin using setLockScreenPin and changeLockScreenPin
  • A method to toggle the WiFi state using setWifiEnabled and get the current WiFi state using getWifiEnabled
  • A method to clear user applications cache and userdata using clearAllAppCacheUserData and clearAppCacheUserData
  • APIs to enable ADB using setAdbEnabled, and to set custom ports for ADB using customePortAdb
  • Enable/Disable Home button on the device using setHomeButtonEnabled
  • Enable/Disable Power button on the device using setPowerButtonEnabled
  • Enable/Disable Text Editor assist menu using setTextEditorAssistMenuEnabled
  • Enable/Disable the 'show more' options on the volume panel setVolumePanelShowMoreEnabled
  • Enable/Disable Zebra Barcode scanner using setBarcodeReaderEnabled
  • Perform a scan using zebra Barcode scanner setScanBarcodeReaderEnabled
  • Enable/disable Elo Logging feature using setEloLoggingEnabled
  • Enable/Disable random WiFi MAC address using setRandomWifiMacAddressEnabled
  • Enable/Disable Star Printer access from WebView via JavaScript interface setStarPeripheralConnectEnabled
  • check if auto allowing USB permissions is enabled or disabled using getAutoAllowUSBPermission
  • Set the device owner using setDeviceOwner, remove the device owner using removeDeviceOwner(java.lang.String) removeDeviceOwner}, and get the device owner status using getDeviceOwnerStatus() getDeviceOwnerStatus}
  • Set/get the Display DPI using setDpi and getDpi
  • Set and get the current language on the device using setLanguage and getLanguage
  • Set and get the type of lock on the device setLockType and getLockType
  • Set and get the status of Multi Client IME using setMultiClientImeEnabled and getMultiClientImeEnabled
  • Set/get the NTP server URL using setNtpServerUrl and getNtpServerUrl
  • Set/get the NTP poll interval using setNtpPollInterval and getNtpPollInterval
  • Enable/Disable install permissions to specific apps using setInstallPermissionToSpecificApp or to all apps using setInstallAllAppPermissionEnabled
  • Check which apps have install permissions using getInstallPermissionToSpecificApp
  • Set/get the display resolution using setScreenSize and getScreenSize
  • Set/get the smallest pixel width as shown in developer options setSmallestPixelWidth and getSmallestPixelWidth
  • Set/get the Timezone using setTimeZone and getTimeZone
  • Enable/Disable accessibility services using setAccessibilityService
  • Enable/Disable auto Date and time using setAutoDateTimeEnabled
  • Enable/Disable Bluetooth device pairing confirmation dialog for specific devices using setBluetoothDevicePairingConfirmationEnabled
  • Set the Date and Time on the device using setDateTime
  • Set Display size (Default/Large/Larger/Largest) using setDisplaySize
  • Set Wi-Fi network configuration using a CSV file setEloNetworkConf
  • Set Font size using setFontSize
  • Enable/Disable Idle mode using setIdleModeEnabled
  • Set Location of the device using setLocationEnabled
  • Mute/Un-mute microphone using setMicrophoneMuteEnabled
  • Enable/Disable showing the password while typing it in using setPasswordEnabled
  • Enable/Disable Google Playprotect using setPlayProtect
  • Set/Get the reserved log space on the device using setReservedLogSpace and getReservedLogSpace
  • Set the time format on the device using setTimeFormatEnabled
  • Enable/Disable the touch sound on the device using setTouchSoundEnabled
  • Set volume level for various volume types such as Alarm, Call, Media, Notification using setVolumeLevel
  • Enable/Disable the 'share' option when text is selected on the device using setShowTextEditorShareMenuEnabled
  • Shutdown the device using silentShutDown
  • Set the default launcher on the device using setSilentDefaultLauncher
  • Lock/unlock the secure processor firmware using setFirmwareStatusLockEnabled, get the status using getFirmwareStatusLockEnabled and upgrade the firmware using spFirmwareUpgrade
  • show notification and start activity from Foreground service using startActivityFromForegroundService
  • Enable/Disable the dark mode on the device using setDarkModeEnabled
  • Wake-up the device screen if it is asleep using wakeupScreen
  • Enable/Disable the charging sound and vibration on the device using setChargingSoundAndVibrationEnabled
  • Enable/Disable the screen locking sound on the device using setScreenLockSoundEnabled
  • Enable/Disable the idle mode tile on the device using setIdleModeTileEnabled
  • Get the host name of the device using getHostName
  • Set the host name of the device using setHostName
  • Enable/Disable the hotspot accessibility on the device using setHotspotAccessibilityEnabled
  • Get the hotspot accessibility on the device using getHotspotAccessibilityEnabled
  • Get the MD5 checksum of a file using getMD5Checksum
  • Bind and unBind the Service in order to start using the System APIs using bindService unbindService

    • setKeyListener

      public boolean setKeyListener(String packageName, String receiverName, ArrayList<Integer> keys, ArrayList<Boolean> intercept)
      Registers a BroadcastReceiver to receive key events from the system.

      When registered, your BroadcastReceiver will receive key events via the action com.elo.secure.action.INTERCEPT_KEY_EVENT. The key event data is passed in the Intent extras.

      Implementing the BroadcastReceiver

      Create a BroadcastReceiver in your application that handles the key event action:

       public class MyKeyEventReceiver extends BroadcastReceiver {
     @Override
     public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
         if ("com.elo.secure.action.INTERCEPT_KEY_EVENT".equals(intent.getAction())) {
             // Key event data is in the intent extras
             Bundle extras = intent.getExtras();
             // Process the key event
         }
     }
 }

      AndroidManifest.xml Registration

      Register your receiver in the manifest with the appropriate intent filter:

       <receiver android:name=".MyKeyEventReceiver"
           android:exported="true">
     <intent-filter>
         <action android:name="com.elo.secure.action.INTERCEPT_KEY_EVENT" />
     </intent-filter>
 </receiver>
      Parameters:
      packageName - Name of package the key listener component belongs to
      receiverName - Fully qualified class name of the BroadcastReceiver (use MyReceiver.class.getName())
      keys - ArrayList of keycode integers to listen for. Use KeyEvent.KEYCODE_VOLUME_UP, etc.
      intercept - ArrayList of booleans corresponding to each key. If true, the key event is consumed and not passed to the foreground app. If false, both the receiver and foreground app receive it.
      Returns:
      true if the key listener was registered successfully, false otherwise

    • setAutoAllowUsbPermissionEnabled

      public void setAutoAllowUsbPermissionEnabled(boolean grantPermission)
      This method is used to grant runtime usb permissions in AndroidHomeMode.
      After applying changes device requires reboot to reflect the changes.
      ON 3.0 DEVICES THIS METHOD WILL TOGGLE THE USB PERMISSIONS AND THE VARIABLE 'grantPermission' IS NOT USED.
      SO FOR EXAMPLE IF AUTOMATICALLY ALLOWING USB PERMISSIONS IS CURRENTLY NOT ENABLED FOR AN APP, CALLING
      THIS FUNCTION WILL ENABLE IT. AND IF AUTO ALLOWING USB PERMISSIONS IS CURRENTLY ENABLED, THEN CALLING
      THIS FUNCTION WILL DISBALE IT

      To reboot device use silentReboot.

      Parameters:
      grantPermission - boolean (true/false)

    • setScreenWakeUp

      public void setScreenWakeUp(long delay)
      This method is used to wake up the screen if it's asleep. This API can be used to wakeup the screen after a particular
      delay. So for example you can set your device to sleep after a particular amount of idle time using setBackLightTimeout
      and set a wakeup time again using this API.
      Parameters:
      delay - This parameter is a long integer value describing the number of milliseconds after which to wake up the screen. For e.g. 15 seconds = 15*1000. and 30 minute = 30*60*1000 and 8 hours = 8*60*60*1000.

    • registerCallback

      public void registerCallback(com.elo.secure.IElosecureCallback iElosecureCallback)
      Registers a callback to receive asynchronous responses from EloSecure system operations.

      The callback's updateData(String msg) method receives a JSON string with the format:

       {
   "action": "com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_*",
   "RESPONSE_VALUE": "<result>"
 }

      Possible Action Values

      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_CHANGE_WIFI_STATE - WiFi state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_WIFI_SCANNING - WiFi scanning state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_BLUETOOTH_SCANNING - Bluetooth scanning state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_GRANT_ALL_PERMISSION - Auto-grant permission changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_PLAYPROTECT - Play Protect state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_DARK_THEME - Dark mode changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_HOSTNAME - Hostname changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_RANDOMIZED_WIFI_MAC - WiFi MAC randomization changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_IDLE_MODE - Auto idle mode changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_COPY_PASTE_MODE - Copy/paste state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_STICKY_BOOT_MODE - Sticky EloView mode changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_DISABLE_RECENT_BUTTON - Recent button state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SHOWTAPS_ENABLE_DISABLE - Show taps state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SCREEN_LOCKING_SOUND_ENABLE_DISABLE - Screen lock sound changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_ENABLE_OR_DISABLE_LOGS - Logging state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_ENABLE_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICES - Accessibility service changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_ORIENTATION - Screen orientation changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_DPI - Screen density changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_DISPLAY_SIZE - Display size changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_FONT_SIZE - Font size changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_DISABLE_STATUSBAR - Status bar state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_DISABLE_NAVBAR - Navigation bar state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_VIRTUAL_KEYBOARD - Virtual keyboard state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_MULTI_CLIENT_IME - Multi-client IME changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_TIMEZONE - Timezone changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_SET_LOCALE - Locale changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_BLUETOOTH_ENABLE_DISABLE - Bluetooth state changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.ENABLE_HOME_BUTTON - Home button enabled
      • com.elo.secure.action.DISABLE_HOME_BUTTON - Home button disabled
      • com.elo.secure.action.ENABLE_POWER_BUTTON - Power button enabled
      • com.elo.secure.action.DISABLE_POWER_BUTTON - Power button disabled
      • com.elo.secure.action.RES_CHANGE_BOOT_ANIMATION - Boot animation changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RES_CHANGE_CUSTOMER_LOGO - Customer logo changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RES_SET_EDITOR_SHOW_OPTION - Text selection sharing changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RES_SET_WEBVIEW_INTERFACE_OPTION - WebView hardware access changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_ENABLE_STAR_PRINTER - Star printer interface changed
      • com.elo.secure.action.RESPONSE_ENABLE_IDLE_MODE_TILE - Idle mode tile state changed

      Example Usage

       IElosecureCallback callback = new IElosecureCallback.Stub() {
     @Override
     public void updateData(String msg) {
         try {
             JSONObject json = new JSONObject(msg);
             String action = json.getString("action");
             String value = json.getString("RESPONSE_VALUE");
             Log.d("Callback", "Action: " + action + ", Value: " + value);
         } catch (JSONException e) {
             e.printStackTrace();
         }
     }
 };
 system.registerCallback(callback);
      Parameters:
      iElosecureCallback - The callback to register for receiving async responses.
      See Also:
      • unregisterCallback(IElosecureCallback)

    • createMediaProjectionForPackage

      public android.os.IBinder createMediaProjectionForPackage(String packageName, int uid)
      Creates a MediaProjection for the specified package, bypassing the user consent dialog. This method only works if the package has been granted MediaProjection permission via setMediaProjectionPermission(String).

      This allows apps to obtain a MediaProjection token directly without requiring user interaction, which is useful for background services that need screen capture capabilities on pre-authorized devices.

      Parameters:
      packageName - The package name requesting MediaProjection
      uid - The UID of the package (can be obtained from ApplicationInfo.uid)
      Returns:
      IBinder for the IMediaProjection that can be used with MediaProjectionManager, or null if the package is not allowed or an error occurred
